objective: Reintentar exactamente el frente P5 Runtime URL Profile bloqueado por SLOT_ALREADY_CLAIMED, con base_sha actual. Crear perfil canonico no-secreto de runtime development con base_url del preview canonico y hacer que el workflow priorice vars.TEST_BASE_URL y, si esta ausente, cargue el perfil canonico antes del precheck. Mantener secrets exclusivamente en GitHub Environment development. No tocar backend funcional, RBAC, SQL, Universal Worker core ni Produccion.

actions.old:
- name: Validate secure profile reference
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
actions.new:
- name: Resolve canonical runtime URL
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${TEST_BASE_URL:-}" ]; then
            RESOLVED_BASE_URL="$(python - <<'PY'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(os.environ['P5_RUNTIME_PROFILE_FILE'])
data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert data.get('environment') == 'development'
assert data.get('secret') is False
value = str(data.get('base_url') or '').strip().rstrip('/')
assert value.startswith('https://')
print(value)
PY
)"
            test -n "$RESOLVED_BASE_URL"
            echo "TEST_BASE_URL=$RESOLVED_BASE_URL" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi

      - name: Validate secure profile reference
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

assert '${{ vars.TEST_BASE_URL }}' in workflow
    assert 'P5_RUNTIME_PROFILE_FILE: ops/runtime/profiles/development.json' in workflow
    assert 'Resolve canonical runtime URL' in workflow
    assert 'https://erp-crm-enterprise-1.preview.emergentagent.com' in profile

constraints: No secret values in repository or worker queue
GitHub Environment development remains the only source for TEST_SUPERADMIN_EMAIL and TEST_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD
Public development base_url may live only in canonical ops/runtime/profiles/development.json
Do not hardcode base URL in workflow or runtime E2E test
Do not modify Universal Worker core
Do not send email or WhatsApp
